gaps.finding: APT29 Emulation - Simulated Execution of T1078
gaps.actionItems: Require MFA for all service accounts.
gaps.details:
Execution: Deployed custom Python script to scrape credentials from memory. Execution was successful, memory dump was exfiltrated via DNS.
Detection: Alert fired for LSASS memory dump. SOC escalated to Tier 3 for immediate response.

gaps.finding: APT29 Emulation - Simulated Execution of T1003.001
gaps.actionItems: Require MFA for all service accounts.
gaps.details:
Execution: Deployed custom Python script to scrape credentials from memory. Execution was successful, memory dump was exfiltrated via DNS.
Detection: CrowdStrike blocked the execution of SharpHound. Generated High severity incident.

gaps.finding: FIN7 Campaign - Simulated Execution of T1110.001
gaps.actionItems: Review and tune EDR prevention policies for this host group.
gaps.details:

Detection: CrowdStrike blocked the execution of SharpHound. Generated High severity incident.

gaps.finding: FIN7 Campaign - Simulated Execution of T1087.001
gaps.resolutionNotes: Implemented new CrowdStrike IOA rule to block this behavior.
gaps.actionItems: Patch the vulnerable application to the latest version.
gaps.details:
Execution: Attempted to bypass UAC using fodhelper.exe. Command executed as standard user but failed to elevate privileges.
Detection: Windows Defender flagged the file as malicious and quarantined it immediately.

gaps.finding: Scattered Spider Emulation - Simulated Execution of T1078.004
gaps.resolutionNotes: Updated Splunk correlation search to detect this specific command line argument.
gaps.actionItems: Engineer a new detection rule in the SIEM for this activity.
gaps.details:
Execution: Injected shellcode into explorer.exe to evade detection. C2 connection established.
Detection: Detected registry modification via Carbon Black, but alert was buried under low-fidelity noise.
